display_long_description:
# Horizon Dock
Your Productivity Layer for VR

https://www.theoath.studio/horizon-dock

Stop taking off your headset to check your calendar or jot down a note. Horizon Dock puts your essential productivity tools right inside your Quest, floating in your Navigator, always within reach.

## What's Included

- 📝 **Notes**  Create and pin notes anywhere in your space
- ✅ **Tasks** Manage your to-do list with Low, Med, and High priority tags
- 📅 **Calendar**  See your full month at a glance
- 🕐 **Clock & Alarm**  Always know the time, set reminders without leaving VR
- ⚡ **More utilities**  Every update brings a growing set of features built for how you actually use your headset

## Why Horizon Dock

- Completely free  no subscriptions, no hidden costs
- No account or login required
- All data stays on your device  100% private
- Lightweight overlay that works alongside any app or game
- Drag, resize, and pin widgets anywhere in your room

Works on Meta Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest 2.
